This document guides AI agents contributing to `umami-kotlin`, a Kotlin Multiplatform library wrapping the [Umami](https://umami.is/) web analytics REST API for type-safe async use across Android, iOS, JVM, etc.

Main modules:
`:umami`: Core library.
`:sample:simple-compose-app`: Sample Jetpack Compose app.
`:sample:terminalApp`: Sample terminal app.

`:`umami` packages:
`api`: Direct Umami REST API communication.
`core`: HTTP client and event queue.
`domain`: Data models/value objects (e.g., `Hostname`, `Ip`).
